edges.reason: releaseTime constructor argument flows into the constructor body.
token constructor argument flows into the constructor body.
beneficiary constructor argument flows into the constructor body.
releaseTime argument is stored into the _releaseTime state variable.
token argument is stored into the _token state variable.
beneficiary argument is stored into the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor gate compares releaseTime against block.timestamp, making initialization depend on the timestamp.
release() authorization relies on block.timestamp >= _releaseTime, so miner-controllable time gates the transfer.
release() reads the _releaseTime state variable for its time check.
release() reads the _token state variable to query the balance.
_beneficiary state variable is used as the destination of the external token transfer.
release() triggers the external safeTransfer call to the beneficiary.
The locally computed token amount is passed to the external safeTransfer call.
token parameter is supplied to the safeTransfer external call.
to parameter is supplied to the safeTransfer external call.
value parameter is supplied to the safeTransfer external call.
recipient parameter flows into sendValue and is used in the low-level call.
amount parameter flows into sendValue and is forwarded as call value.
sendValue reaches the recipient.call low-level operation.
_functionCallWithValue reaches the target.call low-level operation.
The external token transfer in safeTransfer can call back into release() before any state is finalized.
The recipient low-level call can reenter sendValue's caller before balance effects settle.
The target low-level call can reenter _functionCallWithValue or its callers with all gas forwardable.
